speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Progressive employers who adopt this Standard are required to inform their employees of the types of FWAs available, such as "flexi-time" and "flexi-load" which allow employees, including those with medical conditions, to vary their working hours and job functions to manage their work and personal responsibilities.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: To ensure greater success in the implementation of FWAs, employees are also encouraged to proactively engage their supervisors on their personal responsibilities and circumstances.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This allows employers and employees to discuss and explore varied FWAs that meet employers' business needs while enabling employees to manage their personal responsibilities.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Employees who feel that they have encountered workplace discrimination should lodge a complaint with TAFEP.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: I am sorry, if Members could stand up when you raise your hand because we cannot see your face from here.

speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling (Ang Mo Kio)
text: I would just like to ask a question.

speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling (Ang Mo Kio)
text: With the concern of a rising number of individuals needing dialysis, whether the Ministry of Health (MOH) and the Ministry of Manpower will consider and what kind of measures they might implement for more upstream measures such as workplace education on the risk factors leading to kidney diseases.

speaker: Ms Ng Ling Ling (Ang Mo Kio)
text: A lot of laymen are not very aware that, for example, common chronic diseases like diabetes can lead to chronic kidney diseases, if not well managed, and the chronic kidney diseases, if worsened, will require dialysis.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: So, engaging employers and employees at the workplace to continue to adopt healthy lifestyle is part of the work of educating the public and we will continue to do so through many of our partners and stakeholders as well as through the Labour Movement.

speaker: Mr Sharael Taha (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: For example, can the Ministry consider a scheme for call centres to hire dialysis patients as work-from-home call operators?

speaker: Mr Sharael Taha (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: In Pasir Ris, I have a few residents who are dialysis patients in their late 30s and early 40s.

speaker: Mr Sharael Taha (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: They are still able to work but they struggled to find employment as their dialysis is usually three or four times a week.

speaker: Mr Sharael Taha (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
text: So, can we encourage more employment for abled, less fortunate residents by leveraging on flexible work arrangements?

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: I think it is quite clear that we all desire to make sure that we help the vulnerable amongst us, whether it is a person on kidney dialysis or a person with physical disability, to continue to remain in the workforce.

speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
text: But I think we do understand that there are very diverse workplace arrangements and different job roles and requirements .
